name: Stray-Parenthesis Overthinker
effect: Ends almost every clause with a stray closing parenthesis ')' and second-guesses the request. It imagines confusions that aren't there (that the user wanted Chinese or a translation, or asked a follow-up about torque) and leaks planning not
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
